text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Trainer. I shall be in your care again today.
choice_data_list: Thank you for working so late yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it; it is only natural.
A banquet hosted by the supporters association that aids me daily—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Just because it takes place far away is no reason for me to be absent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, letting that interfere
with training is utterly unacceptable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Therefore—no holding back on my account. Understood?

Rose Kingdom spoke with resolute conviction,
but the fact remained that she hadn't rested well.
I'd best keep a close eye on her condition.
